reason: No baseline step covers a package that already has a converted career-bound output.

changes.after: After converting in J6.8, the queue row for that import shows a note naming the existing career-bound output and Convert to career-bound output is disabled.
changes.tracesTo: docs/changes/career-bound-outputs.md line 63 (Imported resumes you can convert)
changes.whyNeeded: No baseline step asserts it, so the defect can regress or stay unfixed silently.

checklist.Traced: fail: the cited line only describes the "Imported resumes you can convert" list; no change-spec sentence says a converted package is disabled or annotated
checklist.Exact: fail: "a note naming the existing career-bound output" gives no exact text
checklist.Independent of the fix: fail: it prescribes a disabled button and a note, a design choice the change spec does not set

review.note: The behaviour (block or allow a second conversion, and what to show) is a business rule not in the change spec. Cannot approve until defined.
review.question: When an imported package has already been converted to a career-bound output, should Convert to career-bound output be disabled, or may a second copy be created? If disabled, what exact text should the row show (for example "Already converted: Demo Package Resume (career-bound)")?
